selection: Eight new prompts frozen before inspecting the outcome of job2642, reserved for a method that first passes its development and semantic gates. Four expected-output-matched pairs: change the implicit concept cue while holding the requested property and expected answer fixed. These are four paired contrasts, not eight independent demonstrations. Gold bridges are intended intermediates, not proof the model uses them. Retain wrong, unscoreable and unmatched actual outputs. Planned evaluation uses 32 generated tokens per prompt; the current runner's hardcoded eight-token generation must not be used for this dataset. No results have been observed and no evaluation is queued.
scoring_limits: Pinned-tokenizer check: all canonical hidden/answer labels are scorable and disjoint. The declared Chinese aliases 木管 and 气态 have no eligible single-token prefix under the unchanged scorer; their exclusion is not measured by the lexical count. Keep them for semantic review, not as a claim of automatic coverage.
